source.population: greater snow goose spring staging, St. Lawrence Valley

purpose: Assess whether independently measured body condition and anthropogenic disturbance can provide a natural auxiliary axis for heterogeneity in expected waiting/departure cost, without relabeling either variable as PAYOFF-B D.
primary_scientific_boundary: body condition is a state variable, not opportunity cost D by definition
hunting/disturbance is an external context, not D by definition
no q_wait(D) threshold may be estimated from this dataset alone
no GPS cue-uptake outcome from PR #212 may be opened or joined in this branch
current_gate: Resolve public file manifest and README before specifying any response model.
promotion_ceiling: At most support state/context dependence of a D-like deadline axis; exact information-deadline confirmation remains forbidden.
